name: Multi-Market ETF Tracker API
description: Read-only, unauthenticated JSON snapshot of the data shown on https://global-etf-database.streamlit.app/ -- free to use, no API key required.

endpoints.{market-slug}.json: One market's full snapshot (etfs, sectors, sector_rotation, trending). market-slug is the market name lowercased with spaces replaced by hyphens, e.g. india.json, usa.json, usa-ai.json, canada.json.
endpoints.all.json: All markets combined, under a top-level "markets" object keyed by market name.

payload_shape.generated_at: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this snapshot was built
payload_shape.data_through: YYYY-MM-DD, the latest price date included

etfs.ticker: yfinance symbol, e.g. BOTZ or RELIANCE.NS
etfs.broker_ticker: ticker with exchange suffix stripped, what you'd type into a broker
etfs.name: fund name
etfs.sector: sector/theme this ETF is tracked under

sectors.avg_return_1m_pct: number or null, averaged across every tracked ETF in the sector

sector_rotation.from_1m_3m_shift_pct: number, how much the 1M return diverges below the 3M trend
sector_rotation.to_1m_3m_shift_pct: number, how much the 1M return diverges above the 3M trend

trending.name: string
trending.note: string, why this ETF is on the curated trending list

caveats: Prices come from Yahoo Finance via yfinance -- free and unofficial, delayed, not for trading decisions.
sector_rotation is a computed price-momentum proxy, not real fund-flow or social-media data.
trending is a manually curated, periodically-refreshed list, not a live social-media feed.

Snapshots regenerate whenever a human visits the corresponding dashboard page (self-refreshing, no external scheduler). A market's file may be missing or stale for up to an hour if its page hasn't been viewed recently, and can briefly 404 right after a container restart until first visited.
